name: XTR high clamp front derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed average 147.2 g for FD-M9025-H, 2×11-speed, down swing, 34.9 mm high clamp band, without S/M reducer adapters. The weight heading explicitly selects L-size band type; the mount rows distinguish the unadapted 34.9 mm band from 28.6/31.8 mm reducer configurations. Other mount variants do not inherit this weight.
